intro.title: Barcode Scanning & Instant Cart Insertion
intro.subtitle: High-speed handheld scanning, zero-click item addition, and instant totals

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 2: Barcode Scanning. In a busy Indian pharmacy, reaching for the mouse or typing every medicine name creates queues. MediFlow supports all standard USB and wireless barcode scanners out of the box.
Simply point your barcode gun at the medicine box or strip. MediFlow's smart input listener automatically detects high-speed hardware scans without needing you to click the search bar first.
Watch as the barcode is scanned. You hear the confirmation beep, and Azithromycin 500 milligram is instantly inserted into your active cart with its earliest expiring batch and MRP.
The live cart table immediately displays the pack quantity, GST rate, and net payable without a single extra keystroke, keeping your checkout line moving smoothly.
Barcode scanning eliminates dispensing errors and accelerates counter throughput. In Part 3, we will explore Loose Tablet and Strip Cutting for fractional billing.

outro.takeaway: Barcode Scanning: Instantly adds in-stock batches with zero manual clicks, preventing queue bottlenecks.
